bio.text: Carl Bjerke represents Idaho Senate District 5 and lives in Coeur d'Alene; the Idaho Legislature's member page lists a second term.

The legislature biography says Bjerke was born in 1962 in Long Beach, California, and had a 32-year career in public safety, retiring as deputy chief of operations of the Santa Monica Fire Department.
The biography lists an A.S. in respiratory therapy and a B.S. in organizational leadership, and says Bjerke worked as a respiratory therapist before the fire service.
